title: Gate coordinate of the CNF assignment
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits, let $x$ be an input assignment, and let $i$ be a gate of $C$. The extended sign assignment associated with $x$, evaluated at the coordinate for gate $i$, is the sign corresponding to the Boolean value of gate $i$ on input $x$.
